title: Cabinet Approves ₹84,084 Crore 'Samudra Manthan' Offshore Energy Exploration Scheme
summary: Unlocks India's offshore crude oil and gas potential across Krishna-Godavari, Cauvery, and Mahanadi basins.

blocks.content: Unlocks India's offshore crude oil and gas potential across Krishna-Godavari, Cauvery, and Mahanadi basins.

items: Phase-I Outlay: ₹84,084 crore implementation through FY31 under Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas.
Scheme Components: (i) ₹28,534 cr (2D/3D seismic data & NDR AI re-processing); (ii) ₹55,200 cr (drilling 60 deepwater wells); (iii) ₹350 cr (monitoring).
Production Target: Increases domestic oil & gas production from 62 MMTOE to 80 MMTOE annually.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Samudra Manthan Phase-I total outlay (₹84,084 crore) vs deepwater drilling component (₹55,200 crore).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "Why did India launch the risk-sharing Samudra Manthan scheme for deepwater energy exploration?"
💡 **Model Answer: Deepwater wells cost -150M each; state risk-sharing attracts private capital to reduce India's  crude import dependency.**
